scope: Six selected wiring faults; not a general mutation-coverage score.

results.name: rf_source_ports_swapped
results.purpose: RF source-address wiring must preserve rs1 and rs2 roles.
results.evidence: FATAL: ./tb/rv32i_core_checks.svh:16: connection/state: decoder -> RF read addresses pc=00000004 instruction=00008093 state=2

results.name: alu_immediate_mux_bypassed
results.purpose: Immediate ALU instructions must select the decoded immediate.
results.evidence: FATAL: ./tb/rv32i_core_checks.svh:16: connection/state: operands/control -> ALU pc=00000000 instruction=800000b7 state=2

results.name: rf_writeback_bit_corrupted
results.purpose: The physical RF write port must receive the committed result.
results.evidence: FATAL: ./tb/rv32i_core_checks.svh:16: connection/state: writeback -> RF pc=00000000 instruction=00000000 state=0

results.name: store_lane_shift_bypassed
results.purpose: Subword stores must place the low rs2 bytes in addressed lanes.
results.evidence: FATAL: tb/tb_core.sv:158: data txn 16 addr=00000405 we=1 be=2 data=80ff7f01 expected 00000405 1 2 ff7f0100

results.name: pc_advanced_during_fetch_stall
results.purpose: PC and instruction request address must remain stable while stalled.
results.evidence: FATAL: ./tb/rv32i_core_checks.svh:16: connection/state: PC changed outside commit pc=00000004 instruction=00000000 state=1

results.name: jalr_bit_zero_mask_removed
results.purpose: JALR must clear target bit zero before checking IALIGN32.
results.evidence: FATAL: tb/tb_core.sv:113: halt mismatch cause=0 pc=00000274 tval=00000281 ecall=0 break=0 expected 00000003 00000a3c 00000000 0 1
